question: Find the simple interest (in closest integral ₹) on ₹3,000 at 8% per annum rate of interest for the period from 14 February 2024 to 15 April 2024.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate (R) = 8% per annum

Time (T) = 14 Feb 2024 to 15 Apr 2024

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculation:**

Days from 14 Feb to 29 Feb = 15 days (2024 is leap year)

March = 31 days

April = 15 days

Total = 15&nbs
p;+ 31 + 15 = 61 days

Time in years = dfrac{61}{366}

⇒ SI = dfrac{3000 times 8 times 61}{100 times 366}

⇒ SI = 40

∴ The simple interest is ₹40
